Free AI course 2 of 5: Google Skills ⚡

If “AI,” “machine learning” and “generative AI” have started sounding like the same word, this is a good reset. Google’s Introduction to Generative AI is an introductory course listed at about 45 minutes. It explains what gen AI is, how it is used, how it differs from traditional ML, and introduces Google tools for gen AI apps.

Make the 45 minutes count: pause after each section, explain the idea in your own words, then test a tiny example. Try turning a messy idea into three formats in an AI tool and check what it got right or wrong. That challenge is my suggested practice, not a course assignment.

Course: Introduction to Generative AI — Google Skills
https://www.skills.google/course_templates/536

Save this for your next learning break. Which AI term still feels confusing?
